children: Critical Metals Corp said Greenland approved the Tanbreez Mining and Closure Plans, valid to 2050, covering 19 elements including key heavy rare earths. Activity-specific operating permits are now the final step before construction can begin.
De-risks project timeline and permits a multidecade operating horizon.
Enables diversification of revenue streams once in production.
Includes Tb, Dy, Y, Nd, Pr
Access to magnet metals central to EVs, wind, and defense demand.
Construction can start only after these; timing risk remains.
Strategic non-China rare earth supply potential may aid financing.

This is an early-to-mid stage regulatory milestone that advances Tanbreez from license to executable plans but still pre-construction. For a larger catalyst, CRML needs the remaining operating permits, financing terms, and a firm construction start timeline.
